mapper.sql: r.salary_id, r.user_id, r.user_name, u.nick_name as nick_name, r.dept_id, dept.dept_name as dept_name, r.shop_dept_id, shop_dept.dept_name as shop_dept_name, r.salary_month, r.work_days, r.leave_days, r.absent_days, r.scheduled_minutes, r.worked_minutes, r.paid_leave_minutes, r.unpaid_leave_minutes, r.absence_minutes, r.attendance_source_version, r.late_total_minutes, r.early_total_minutes, r.overtime_hours, r.base_salary, r.attendance_deduction, r.late_deduction, r.early_deduction, r.absent_deduction, r.overtime_pay, r.other_bonus, r.other_deduction, r.total_salary, r.status, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark
